text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Tuesday.

- Serbs in the last rebel enclave in Croatia are displeased with the latest government's offer listing their future constitutional rights. They said on local television the document makes them a voting minority in their two counties.
- German newspaper Welt am Sonntag said the number of German tourists who spent their holidays in Croatia doubled last year in comparison with 1995.
- Most issues rose on Croatian stock market in the first week of January despite holidays.
- Road tolls should bring enough money to build 15 kilometers of new highways a year.
- Some 15,000 companies with 130,000 employees might go bankrupt according to new laws that became effective in January.

- Businesman of Croatian descent from New Zealand, Ivo Simunovic offered to invest $ one plus five million to reconstruct the only airport on Brac island, a reknowned ttourist resort, but present owners still wait with the answer. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
